principle: Technical fidelity is a gate; presentation quality and human usefulness are evaluated after the gate.
hard_gates: geometry preserved unless explicit design-change task
unknown source content not silently reinterpreted

checks: line hierarchy supports rather than obscures architecture
critical architecture remains readable at intended output size
shadow/texture/entourage do not mask essential information
empty space is preserved when it improves reading
background is not filled merely for decoration
wood/tile/stone/paving patterns are plausible at drawing scale
saturation does not compete with architecture
secondary diagrams do not compete with the focal information

SALES_PLAN.human_goal: buyer understands spatial organization and practical use quickly
checks: no graphical manipulation of apparent room size

SECTION_PRESENTATION.human_goal: reader understands vertical relationships and spatial/ground conditions quickly

PUBLICATION.human_goal: architecture reads clearly with restrained editorial presentation

COMPETITION_BOARD.human_goal: concept and spatial logic are understood in a deliberate narrative sequence

scoring_policy: Prefer PASS / NEEDS_REVISION / FAIL with evidence notes. Numeric scores may be used only for comparative experiments, not as proof of architectural correctness.
